description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for listing and retrieving ResourceClaimTemplate objects within the Kubernetes client-go listers, specifically for the v1beta1 API version. It includes methods for listing all templates, as well as namespace-specific retrieval.

classes.name: ResourceClaimTemplateLister
classes.description: Interface for listing ResourceClaimTemplates and obtaining namespace-specific listers.

classes.name: resourceClaimTemplateLister
classes.description: Implementation of ResourceClaimTemplateLister interface, using a ResourceIndexer.

classes.name: ResourceClaimTemplateNamespaceLister
classes.description: Interface for listing and getting ResourceClaimTemplates within a specific namespace.

classes.name: resourceClaimTemplateNamespaceLister
classes.description: Implementation of ResourceClaimTemplateNamespaceLister, using a ResourceIndexer.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all ResourceClaimTemplates matching the label selector.

methods.name: ResourceClaimTemplates
methods.description: Returns a namespace-specific lister for ResourceClaimTemplates.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a ResourceClaimTemplate by name within a namespace.
